The two directions create different problems, so the response cannot sit in Planning alone. Increases push on suppliers, capacity and emergency measures. Decreases expose existing purchase commitments and surplus stock. Procurement and Material Flow find decreases easier; Planning finds increases harder; IE finds both equally demanding.
